test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Each of the following questions consists of 4 figures marked 1, 2, 3 and 4 called the Problem Figures followed by 4 other figures. Select a figure from amongst the Answer Figures which will continue the same series as established by the four Problem Figures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57ce3d9fc9c31711b0db2d6c2212fce091847b3eae579632acc5a1f58f074cdc.png]
solution:
**The logic followed here is:**

Top-right symbol shifts in top-left corner, top-left symbol shifts in bottom-right corner.

Bottom-right symbol shifts in bottom-left, bottom-left shifts in middle and middle symbol shifts in top-right corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0955a89d8c3b21ad5a31a6de1c74d9c7c972db03f2c8b9fcef181bd1c496cb5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
